inputs: All10000 fixed reconstructed-label BDD validation images and all7481 previously examined KITTI public labeled training-partition images. Ordered IDs, filenames and dimensions exactly match the previously verified common annotation views; both KITTI variants share one image manifest.
public_contents: Only builder code, aggregate counts/content hashes and this policy. The per-image filename/SHA256 lists, source images and labels are not included in this publication.
checks: Read every encoded image byte for SHA256, verify source-file set and unique IDs/filenames, check JPEG/PNG headers and dimensions, verify stable size/mtime during each read, and bind pinned annotation-view hashes. Exact duplicate image content is reported rather than removed.
duplicate_interpretation: BDD contains9998 distinct encoded image hashes among10000 files: two groups of two identical-byte images. This matches the earlier immutable audit; it is not a newly discovered cross-split leak. KITTI has7481 distinct encoded hashes. No encoded hash is shared between these two evaluation partitions. The prespecified10000/7481 image populations remain unchanged.
historical_scope: The earlier all100k BDD encoded-byte audit recorded no train/validation exact-file overlap. This manifest build rehashes the current evaluation images, not all current training images; do not describe the older train comparison as a new full-training-content audit.
limitations: Content hashes identify these exact files, not official-download authenticity, near-duplicate scenes, sequence independence or COCO pretraining non-overlap. BDD validation has been reused and KITTI was previously examined. No duplicate removal, model selection, coefficient/epoch selection or performance computation occurred.
execution: Read-only input scan with Linux nice19 and idle I/O priority, no GPU access, training restart or environment change. New outputs are isolated, locked and guarded against replacing different existing bytes. Both transferred private manifests were independently hash/count-checked locally.
remaining: GPU inference preflight when a GPU is available without interfering with training; fixed48endpoint hashes after all training/audits; final native BDD and common/native KITTI evaluation orchestration, all scores, analysis and manuscript work.
